observed_architecture.wp804: Correctly emits ABSTAIN when public evidence does not uniquely identify a goal and preserves content-bound public signal provenance.
observed_architecture.hyperposition: Correctly preserves unresolved alternatives without truth, selection or effect authority.
observed_architecture.epistemic_action_selection: Correctly ranks already-bound DiscriminatorCandidate values but consumes caller-supplied expected_information_gain_micros; it does not derive that value from compatible goals or an observation model.

new_minimal_interface_candidate.purpose: Provide the missing auditable bridge from unresolved goal alternatives and legal probes to the numeric expected-information-gain field already consumed by the existing selector.
must_bind: legal probe/action ids and their authorization-neutral candidate identity
probe-outcome or observation-likelihood model ref + generation + sha256
explicit prior policy ref + generation + sha256; uniform-compatible-set is an assumption, not inferred truth
fail_closed_on: probe not present in the bounded legal candidate set

why_not_new_ambiguity_subsystem: The E4 result shows that the existing Hyperposition representation and deterministic epistemic selector are sufficient once a defensible score is supplied. The missing mechanism is the typed causal derivation of that score, not another persistent ambiguity store or another action selector.
external_mechanism_alignment: IRL identifiability work establishes that multiple reward functions can remain compatible with observed behavior, so collapsing ambiguity to one inferred goal is generally unjustified.

CIRL formalizes unknown human reward parameters as partial information and admits active-learning/information-gathering behavior, implying that useful epistemic action requires a belief/observation model rather than a bare ambiguity flag.
acceptance_gates_before_e5: typed immutable binding with exact digest/generation checks
deterministic derivation test: same bound inputs -> same score digest
permutation invariance for alternative and probe ordering
matched probe-switch ablation retained from E4
negative tests for missing/stale/mutated outcome model and scoring policy
explicit no-prior mode must not silently masquerade as calibrated expected information gain
no model/provider call required for deterministic synthetic path
measure CPU/latency/allocation overhead and prove it is negligible relative to current EAS path
no new canonical state or effect path
resource_implication: Expected low runtime cost: one compact deterministic score computation per legal probe over the unresolved alternative set; no additional model call is justified by this E4 result. Exact cost remains UNMEASURED until the typed binding is implemented and benchmarked.
counterhypothesis: A simpler non-probabilistic discriminator heuristic may outperform Shannon-style information gain under sparse or uncalibrated alternatives; therefore the scoring ABI must bind the scoring policy instead of hardcoding one metric as truth.
falsifier: If an implementation with exact model/prior/scoring bindings cannot outperform or meaningfully differentiate the binary-ABSTAIN baseline on matched ambiguity fixtures without hand-authored case-specific scores, retire the adapter hypothesis and keep WP804 ABSTAIN terminal at that boundary.
